page.title: Weigh it yourself: which side is winning for you? | Unless I See
page.description: Go through the key facts about the Shroud of Turin, say what you think of each, and see which side, authentic or medieval, is winning for you.
page.lede: Fourteen key points from the case file. For each one, say what you think. As you answer, you will see which side is winning for you, and the strongest argument against each point.
page.resultH: Which side is winning for you
page.strongest: What weighs most in your answers:
page.caveat: This is not a probability and not a proof. It only adds up your own answers. The two strongest arguments count three times as much as an ordinary point. Disagreeing with a point counts for the other side.
page.teaser:
Most debates about the Shroud come down to a handful of facts and how much each one should count. So we built a simple tool. Go through the key points, say whether you think each one is true, and see which side is winning for you.

Next to each point you will find the strongest argument against it, so you can test your own answer.

verdict.none: Answer a few points to see where you land.
verdict.for: For you, the case for authenticity is winning.
verdict.against: For you, the case for a medieval origin is winning.
verdict.close: For you, it is close. Neither side is clearly ahead.
